name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Redesigned the settings page's visual style: a consistent spacing/color/radius system now underlies every card, status pill, and alert banner instead of one-off values accumulated across many releases, and the four sections used most often - status, Downloads, Add a friend, and People - now visually stand out from the rarely-touched advanced/diagnostic sections. Collapsed sections got a proper disclosure-triangle indicator, focus states were added to the page's own custom interactive elements (Select all/Clear, collapsible section headers, checkbox rows), and layout now compresses gracefully in a narrower browser window instead of using fixed spacing. Purely visual - no endpoint, field, or behavior changed.

198 tests (unchanged).
